title.text: Can an Algorithm be used to determine whether a PV is required or not based on the context of the tool? If yes, what are the most important factors and how should they be weighted?

details.comment: According to IS-G every IT-Asset and IT-Product needs a PV is a regulatory requrirement. now as mentioned on other places different repository leads and stackholder have different understanding semantically and hence different implementation of product, Asset, TK and AWS but i think we need to scope the implementation of EPM and thus require for some scripts, batch files to be excluded from having PV and PV-light or perhaps not even requireing PV so we need it but it needs to be discussed
